Based on the search results, here's what I found about Mistral AI's SAML SSO documentation and identity providers:

## Overview
SSO lets users in your Organization authenticate with their existing corporate identity provider (IdP) credentials using SAML 2.0.

## Supported Identity Providers
Mistral AI supports any compliant IdP, including Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), and Google Workspace. More generally, any compliant SAML IdP can work, with the most commonly used providers being Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory).

## Key Requirements
To set up SAML SSO, you'll need:
- An Enterprise plan to configure SAML SSO
- SAML metadata XML from your IdP

## Configuration Details
You must copy the ACS URL (Assertion Consumer Service URL) and Entity ID from the Mistral modal window and paste them into the corresponding fields in your IdP configuration. Additionally, you must map attributes in your IdP's SAML application configuration: map the user's first name attribute to firstName, the last name attribute to lastName, and configure the Name ID Format to be EmailAddress.

## Protocol Support
OIDC isn't supported; Mistral AI uses SAML 2.0 only for enterprise SSO.

The official documentation is available at https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/security-access/sso for more detailed setup instructions.

input.prompt: What identity providers does this page list as most commonly supported for SAML SSO, and does it say other SAML-compliant IdPs can be used?

content.content:
# SAML SSO Identity Provider Support

The page lists three commonly supported identity providers:

1. "**Microsoft Entra ID** (formerly Azure Active Directory)"
2. "**Google Workspace** / Google Identity Platform"
3. "**Okta**"

Regarding broader support, the documentation states that "Any compliant SAML IdP can work," meaning organizations aren't limited to these three providers. The page directs users to consult their specific provider's documentation for setup instructions.

content.text:
According to Mistral's docs, the SAML SSO page lists three identity providers as the most commonly supported:

1. **Microsoft Entra ID** (formerly Azure Active Directory)
2. **Google Workspace** / Google Identity Platform
3. **Okta**

Yes, you can use a different one — the docs explicitly state that **any SAML 2.0–compliant IdP can work**, not just the three listed. Note that this is SAML-only; OIDC isn't supported for enterprise SSO. Configuration also requires an Enterprise plan and mapping standard attributes (firstName, lastName, Name ID = EmailAddress) plus the ACS URL/Entity ID from Mistral into your IdP.

Sources:
- [SAML SSO | Mistral Docs](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/set-up-organization/sign-in-method/saml-sso)
- [SSO | Mistral Docs](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/security-access/sso)
- [Which Identity Providers (IdPs) do you support for SSO? | Mistral AI Help Center](https://help.mistral.ai/en/articles/424361-which-identity-providers-idps-do-you-support-for-sso)
